chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahboub from Al-ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:

Whoever defecates upon a grave, or urinates standing, or urinates in water while standing, or walks in one shoe, or drinks standing, or isolates himself alone in a house, and sleeps upon dripping [food] stains, then something from the Shaytan will strike him; it will not leave him unless Allah wills it, and the quickest that Shaytan comes to the human being is when he is upon one of these states.

For the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went out in a military brigade, so he came to the Valley of the Jinn. He called out to his companions: 'Let each man from you hold the hand of his companion; no man should enter alone, nor should a man pass alone.'

He said: So a man went forward alone and reached it, and he had been struck with fits. So he was informed of that by the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so he took his thumb and touched him, then said: 'In the Name of Allah, get out, Wicked one! I am the Messenger of Allah.' He said: So he stood up.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific actions and states that make a person vulnerable to Shaytan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi links specific physical postures and states of solitude to spiritual vulnerability, reflecting the Shia emphasis on maintaining ritual purity and awareness of the unseen world in daily conduct. The narrative of the Prophet in Wadi Majannah serves as a practical precedent, illustrating how Shaytan exploits moments of isolation and improper posture, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the tangible influence of jinn on human health and behavior.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who defecates upon a grave or urinates standing, or urinates in water standing, or walks in one shoe, or drinks standing, or isolates himself alone in a house, and sleeps upon dripping hands (from food stains), so something from the Satan<sup>la</sup> hits him, it would not leave him except if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires it, and the quickest of what the Satan<sup>la</sup> comes upon the human being is when he is upon one of these states.

Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> went out in a military brigade, so he<sup>saww</sup> came to a valley of the Jinn. So he<sup>saww</sup> called out to his<sup>saww</sup> companions: ‘Let each man from you grab the hand of his companions, and no man should enter alone, nor should a man go past it alone’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So a man went forward alone and ended up to it, and he had epileptic fits. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was informed with that, so he<sup>saww</sup> grabbed with his thumb and touched him, then said: ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Get out, Wicked one, I<sup>saww</sup> am Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So he stood up’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Mahbub al-‘ Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

‘Unless Allah wills otherwise, something from Satan reaches very fast to one who defecates on a grave or urinates standing or urinates in stagnant water or walks in one shoe or drinks water standing, or stays in a house alone or sleeps overnight with his hands greasy with animal fat.

The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, once travelled in a group of people during an armed expedition and reached in the valley where Jinns lived. He (the Messenger of Allah) called his companions saying, ‘Every one of you must hold the hand of another one and no one must enter alone and no one must walk ahead.’

One man moved forward alone, he completed the area of the valley but he became epileptic. The Messenger of Allah was informed about it and he (the Messenger of Allah) pressed his finger against him and touched, then said, ‘In the name of Allah, O filthy (Jinn) move out, I am the Messenger of Allah.’ He then stood up.’”
